Dettol apologises for advert criticised as sexist in China

Dettol has apologised after an advertisement released in China was accused of reinforcing sexism, despite its stated intention to challenge it. The advert, which reportedly focused on a man seeking a 'clean and untouched' woman, sparked backlash on social media. The company stated the ad was intended to criticise "toxic men" but was withdrawn following the criticism.
